purpose: Trial explicit official team-season big_chance_missed totals against all 38 full official match responses. Only exact season-total exhaustion can qualify omitted match counters as zero. If the opponent missed no big chance, the keeper saved no big chance.
controls: All closed compatible keeper big-chance saves in selected seasons, not an independent holdout. Freeze predictions before comparisons.
application: Only missing_data empty targets; no default zeros, xG threshold or new scoring. Complete team-season identity, full 38-match inventory and explicit integer season total required. Positive residual abstains. Positive known keeper values veto a proposed zero.
